project_type: Python 3.12 serverless microservice using AWS SAM (Lambda + API Gateway HTTP API v2 + DynamoDB)
build_system: AWS SAM (template.yaml). No local build step required - just run tests.
test_framework: pytest + moto (@mock_aws decorator). Tests in tests/unit/. conftest.py has make_api_event() helper, dynamodb_table fixture, order_service fixture.
verification_instructions: 1. Install deps: pip install -r requirements.txt -r requirements-dev.txt; 2. Run tests: pytest tests/unit/ -x -v; 3. Confirm all tests pass including new state transition tests.
environment_constraints: No AWS account available. No SAM CLI needed. Use moto for DynamoDB mocking in tests. No Docker build needed.
contribution_requirements: Follow coding-conventions.md: thin handlers delegating to service layer, (str, Enum) pattern, module-level service instantiation. Follow testing-standards.md: @mock_aws class decorator, import handlers inside test methods, use make_api_event() helper.
key_patterns: Handlers: thin, parse input + delegate to service + format response. Service layer: business logic + DynamoDB. Custom exceptions: OrderNotFoundError, OrderConflictError. Response helpers: success() and error() in src/utils/response.py. Auth: get_user_claims() returns {sub, email, groups}, require_admin() validates admin group. API errors use error codes: BAD_REQUEST, NOT_FOUND, CONFLICT, INTERNAL_ERROR.
directory_structure: services/order-service/src/handlers/ - one handler per endpoint; services/order-service/src/services/ - business logic; services/order-service/src/models/ - dataclass models; services/order-service/src/utils/ - shared utilities; services/order-service/tests/unit/ - pytest unit tests
